DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: expanded band node
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A dedicated mechanoid-band amplifier.\n\nActivation requirement: at least one non-downed colonist at this outpost with Intellectual 8 or higher. One qualified colonist can maintain all mechanitor relays and expanded band nodes at the outpost. While enabled and tuned, this node provides 2 bandwidth to its linked mechanitor.
